items.title: Synaptics (SYNA) Tops Q1 Earnings Estimates
items.summary: Synaptics (SYNA) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +2.44% and -7.59%, respectively, for the quarter ended September 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

items.title: The AI Trade Just Had Its Worst Day Since The Pandemic
items.summary: Nvidia gave back its entire 2026 gain in one session as Wall Street reprices the AI buildout after the midterms.

items.title: 'They're shooting the generals': AI trade stocks drop as hedge funds rush to protect 2026 gains
items.summary: The AI trade's marquee stocks have taken a beating over the past month, sparking warnings on Wall Street of an institutional shakeout as investors move to lock in gains.

items.title: Applied Materials Stocks Fall 12% Before a $10.25 Billion Revenue Test
items.summary: Next week's earnings will test whether strong chip-equipment guidance survives a tougher investment backdrop.

items.title: Applied Materials Sinks 12%, Lam Research Down 14% as Chip Stock Rout Deepens After Midterms
items.summary: Key TakeawaysApplied Materials fell 12% today as the chip sell-off that began after the midterms deepened, pulling down Lam Research, KLA and Teradyne. Investors fear data-center spending will slow, and Qualcomm’s weak guidance didn’t help.

items.title: AMAT Shares Plunge 30% in a Month: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold?
items.summary: Applied Materials' stock declines amid semiconductor industry concerns, but AI-driven equipment demand and advanced packaging growth are tailwinds.

items.title: Astera Labs Sinks 12%, Dell Technologies Down 8% as Chip Stocks Slide Again
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAstera Labs fell 12% as a weak phone-chip outlook and a chip designer’s royalty miss hit chip stocks, including Dell Technologies and Applied Materials. Both problems came from phones and memory costs, not data centers.
